cover.house: A board and batten gable sits over the front porch of this East End bungalow, with Hardi Plank siding on the walls, a new roof overhead and a new driveway along the side. Inside, one wood-look floor runs from the Living Room through the Dining Area to the Kitchen, and the Primary Bedroom sits at the back under a vaulted ceiling. The wiring, breaker box and plumbing are new, and the house has three-phase power.

photos.title: Living Room
photos.body: A tall window faces the street, and a clerestory window high on the wall adds daylight above eye level. A wide cased opening on the far side leads to the Dining Area and the Kitchen, and the same wood-look floor runs through all three.

photos.title: Front Entry
photos.body: The wood front door has a window at its top. Past it, the wood-look floor runs back to the Kitchen without a threshold.

photos.title: Kitchen
photos.body: An L-shaped layout with a peninsula, white shaker-style upper cabinets, dark navy lower cabinets and marble-look counters and backsplash. The stainless steel range, sink and dishwasher sit along the L, and the pantry, 4'7" x 3'4", is around the corner.

photos.title: Breakfast Bar
photos.body: Two pendant lights hang over the peninsula that divides the Kitchen from the Dining Area, a step from the range.

right.title: The Primary suite and two more bedrooms

colA.title: Primary Bedroom
colA.body: A vaulted ceiling with an exposed painted beam rises over the room, with windows on two walls. The double-door closet is on one wall and a doorway leads to the bath, at the back of the house away from the street.

colA.title: Primary Bath
colA.body: Double sinks sit on a dark navy vanity under an LED backlit mirror. The walk-in shower is tiled in marble-look tile, with a glass door, a rain showerhead and a handheld.

colA.title: Primary Closet
colA.body: Double doors open to a built-in shelving tower with hanging rods on both sides and shelves above. The shelving stays with the house.

colB.title: Bedroom 2
colB.body: The larger secondary bedroom sits in a front corner, with a window on each outside wall and a ceiling fan overhead. The door opens to the hall, next to Bedroom 3 and a few steps from the hall bath.

colB.title: Bedroom 3
colB.body: The closet is on the hall side, so the window wall stays open for a desk or a dresser. A ceiling fan hangs overhead, and the hall bath is a few steps away.

colB.title: Hall Bath
colB.body: A tub with full-height marble-look tile, a pebble tile niche and a window above it, shared by Bedrooms 2 and 3.

back.title: From the Breakfast Nook to the yard

meals.title: Dining Area
meals.body: The Dining Area sits between the Kitchen peninsula and the hall to the bedrooms, with a sputnik-style fixture overhead. The Living Room is a step toward the front and the Kitchen a step toward the back.

meals.title: Breakfast Nook
meals.body: Windows on two walls light the nook, which sits at the back of the house beside the Kitchen. A door opens out to the backyard deck, and the pantry is a few steps away.

outdoor.title: Open Patio and Covered Garage
outdoor.body: At the back of the lot, behind the house, an open concrete patio sits beside the covered garage, and a fence surrounds the whole yard. The garage is the covered space, and the patio is open to the sky.
